ModMetaData.name: Gas Wall Torches [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Wall-mounted torches powered by your Helixien gas network. No wood refills Choose from four flame types, all using the vanilla wall torch graphics and building icon. Mount them on a wall, connect them to gas and use the manual switch, or let LightsOut turn them on and off Made at the request of svg FEATURES • Warm flame – warm light, with no DLC required • Bloodflame – red light and a +2 mood bonus for nearby pawns with an active bloodfeeder gene • Toxflame – green light and a +2 mood bonus for nearby pawns with an active pollution stimulus gene. Does not produce pollution • Darkflame – darklight instead of ordinary light Each torch has a light radius of 10 tiles and consumes 0.02 Helixien gas per game tick while burning. The bloodflame and toxflame bonuses apply within 7 tiles of a burning torch of the matching type Switching a torch off stops its flame, light, heat, sound and gas use. It also goes out when its gas supply runs dry HOW TO USE The torches appear under Architect → Furniture after you finish Gas extraction in the Vanilla Expanded research tab. This research requires Smithing; the building commands are hidden until it is completed Each torch costs 15 steel. Place one against a wall in any of four directions and connect its tile to a Helixien gas pipe Use the torch's switch to turn it on or off With LightsOut (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2584269293) installed, the torch follows that mod's lighting rules for the room it faces. Automatic shutoff extinguishes the flame and stops the light, heat, sound and gas use LightsOut turns the torch back on when its room rules allow it, provided the torch has gas and its manual switch is on. Switching it off manually keeps it off. Use LightsOut's Keep On control to exclude a torch from automatic shutoff COMPATIBILITY Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077), Vanilla Expanded Framework (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2023507013) and Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2877699803). Load this mod after its dependencies Bloodflame and toxflame require Biotech; darkflame requires Ideology. The warm torch is available without either DLC. Includes English and Russian text LightsOut is optional. If installed, load it before Gas Wall Torches. It can automatically control all four torches added by this mod FEEDBACK Found a bug?
